title: Add provider disclosures and keep the DPA as an internal draft
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Adds a subprocessors page linked from the site header and footer, naming infrastructure, inference, and hosted-tool providers and explaining routing and retention limitations. Updates the Privacy Policy and removes references to an unpublished DPA from the simplified Terms header while preserving existing notice and deletion commitments. Keeps the draft DPA in operations/legal, outside website assets and navigation, and adds rules for maintaining provider documentation. Live media and generation R2 lifecycle policies expire objects after 30 days; media reads can refresh that clock.
